assign.request: Build the panel-flow recorder: a recorded progression of panel steps you can replay and step through. The owner, verbatim: "A panel flow is like, a recorded progression of panel steps. So when you're testing, and you start, split, split, resize, etc... each step, each action, is a step, that you can replay, step through, etc. That way, when you're done, I can see exactly what you've created." And: "Using the panel flow, I want to be able to start from an empty full screen panel, and step through to observe the creation of complex layouts. I want to get a full tour of all the features." Plus strategy step 5: the demo.stage(() => panel(seed)) composition as one demo block.
assign.now: scoping — read the brief, the proposal, workspace.js, Item.js and stage.js
steps: read the brief, proposal S3/S4/S5, workspace.js, Item.js, stage.js
flow.js — record root change/add/remove as {at, snapshot}, bursts coalesced
replay — Item.hydrate(snapshot) + redraw, guarded so replay never records
the scrubber strip + flow.css (panel-flow-, @layer theme, under 40 lines)
page.js — mount the scrubber on / and /full/, plus the demo.stage(() => panel(seed)) block
prove it headless: six real steps, step back to 1 and forward to 6, bit-identical toJSON, two screenshots
docs — readme Use + Watch out, doc/flow.md, doc/decisions.md entry

log.msg: PROVEN on /full/ at 1280: six gestures (split right, split bottom, display flex, a real 16-move seam drag, sow, close) recorded exactly 6 steps; verbs read '+2 panels | +2 panels | display | grow | +12 panels | -2 panels'. Stepped back to 1 (3 panels), to 3 (5 panels, flow-step-3.png), forward to 6 (flow-step-6.png). step-6 snapshot 1513 chars sha256 4c87985879a8968f == live root.toJSON() 1513 chars sha256 4c87985879a8968f (EQUAL true); still 6 steps after the replay, so a replayed step does not record itself. git status public/data Server/data clean (page.routeWebSocket(/.*/) blocks the dev socket).

finding — root.toJSON() is SHALLOW: json.data is the live data object and json.items are live Items, so a recorded step would rewrite itself on the next set(). A step captures JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(root)).

finding (not mine to fix) — insert.js's '+' is z-index 5 over grip.js's 2, so it EATS the seam drag: a row split's bar covers the top 2.2rem of its seam, and a nested column split's bar covers 2.2rem of its left edge at the height of its own gap — i.e. the middle of the outer seam. Pressing there opens nothing and moves nothing. Supports the panel-complexity verdict that insert.js should go.

finding — an SPA keeps the doc page (one workspace + five demo panels) mounted behind /full/, so 'the last flow' is not the visible one; flow.js keeps Flow.mounted, pruned to connected roots, and a driver picks with .find(f => f.$root.el.closest('.layout-full')).

assign.outcome:
**Panel-flow landed — every gesture is a step you can replay.** `flow.js` (199 lines) + `flow.css` (39) record a workspace's whole history in memory and step through it; the scrubber strip sits under the workspace on [`/framework/ext/Panel/`](/framework/ext/Panel/) and [`/full/`](/framework/ext/Panel/full/).

**Proven headless on `/full/` at 1280**, dev socket blocked (`git status public/data` clean throughout): six gestures — split right · split bottom · `display: flex` · a real 16-move seam drag · `sow` · `close` — recorded exactly **6 steps**, verbs `+2 panels · +2 panels · display · grow · +12 panels · −2 panels`. Stepped back to 1 (3 panels), to 3 (5 panels), then forward to 6: `JSON.stringify(root.toJSON())` is **byte-identical** to the recorded step-6 snapshot — 1,513 chars, same sha256, both sides — and the flow still holds 6 steps, so a replayed step does not record itself.

![step 6, live](flow-step-6.png)

![step 3, replaying](flow-step-3.png)

**Read:** [`doc/flow.md`](/framework/ext/Panel/doc/flow/) — what a step is, why snapshots and not diffs, the guard, the cost. Notes: `doc/file/flow.js.md`, `doc/file/flow.css.md`; one entry in `doc/decisions.md`; two lines in the readme.

**A step is the whole tree.** `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(root))` — ⚠ `root.toJSON()` alone hands back the LIVE `data` and the LIVE children, so a step taken from it rewrites itself on the next `set()`. Replay is `Item.hydrate` + one redraw, no inverse-operation table. One gesture is one step (a trailing 150ms debounce; one `divide()` fires three events). `workspace.js` gained 7 lines: an import and `record(root, $root)` after the first draw.

**The stage stays a composition** — `demo.stage(() => panel(seed))` landed as one demo block on `page.js`, no `panel.stage()` helper and no class: every `demo()` on that page already builds a stage, so naming it was the work.

**Found, not fixed (another task's files):** `insert.js`'s `+` is `z-index: 5` over `grip.js`'s `2` and **eats a seam drag** — a row split's bar covers the top 2.2rem of its seam, and a nested column split's bar covers the middle of the outer seam. One more measurement under the standing proposal to delete `insert.js`.

**Left:** nothing writes a flow to disk (`flow.save()` hands back the array — a file format and a "play the tour" button are the next question); no `reset()` verb, so a driver re-baselines by hand; the flex/grid guides are not rebuilt as flows yet.
